model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC percentage for various methods. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" and has a logarithmic scale with a value range of 1 to 10^4, with tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" and has a linear scale with a value range of 40 to 65, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot displays six lines, each representing a different method: Base (black, circle markers, solid line), FT (blue, triangle markers, solid line), IKE (red, triangle markers, solid line), MEND (brown, square markers, solid line), MEMIT (purple, diamond markers, solid line), and ROME (green, circle markers, solid line). The Base line starts at approximately 39 and increases to 44, the FT line starts at 41 and increases to 48, the IKE line starts at 44 and increases to 51, the MEND line starts at 44 and increases to 56, the MEMIT line starts at 46 and increases to 54, and the ROME line starts at 52 and increases to 65.
